sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: We collect your email address, your display name and, for talents, the profile text you write: headline, description, city, work mode, languages, skills, portfolio links and an optional video link.
Talents may also enter a self-declared visa type and contact channels (email, Telegram, KakaoTalk and similar). We do not verify the visa type.
We keep logs of who revealed which contact details and of reports about profiles, and a record of the legal documents you accepted with the version, the interface language and the time.
Your IP address is used only in the rate limiter's memory to slow down abuse and is not stored in the database.

sections.heading: Why we use it
paragraphs: We use your data to run your account, show talent profiles to clients, let signed-in clients contact talents, keep the service safe and prove which documents you accepted.
We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising or analytics.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Your data is kept until you delete your account, plus a grace period of 14 days in which you can cancel the deletion. After that the data is removed and audit records are anonymised.
If an account was hidden by moderation, we keep a salted hash of the email, the reason code and the date for 1 year to prevent re-registration under the same email.

sections.heading: Where your data is stored
paragraphs: The main database is stored in Korea (Supabase, Seoul region).

Some processors run outside Korea: Vercel (website hosting), Render in Singapore (API hosting), Resend (email delivery), Google (sign-in with Google) and Cloudflare R2 (file storage). They receive only the data they need to perform their task.

sections.heading: Who sees your contact details
paragraphs: Contact details of a talent are shown only to signed-in clients with a verified email who press the Contact button. Every reveal is logged.
Public pages never show contact details.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can view and edit your data, and delete your account, at My account (/me/account). You can cancel a deletion within 14 days.
You may also ask us to explain how your data is handled by writing to the contact below.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: We use two httpOnly session cookies that keep you signed in, and one language preference cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) set by the interface language switcher.
We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.

sections.heading: Contact
paragraphs: For privacy questions write to {email}.

sections.heading: What this service is
paragraphs: SkillBoard Korea is a listing board where foreigners in South Korea post their skills and clients, companies or private persons, find and contact them.
We are not an employer, an agency or a party to any agreement between a talent and a client.

sections.heading: Accounts
paragraphs: You must give accurate information and keep your password safe. You are responsible for what happens under your account.
We do not verify the identity, the visa or the qualifications of users. Check the person you work with before you agree on anything.

sections.heading: Content rules
paragraphs: Do not post anything illegal, misleading, discriminatory, sexually explicit or infringing someone else's rights.
Do not use the service to spam, scam, collect other people's data or ask for payment before work is agreed.

sections.heading: Moderation
paragraphs: We may hide a profile, delete content or block an account that breaks these terms or that other users report.
A blocked person may not register again with the same email.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: The service is provided as it is, without guarantees of availability, results or the behaviour of other users.
To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for losses from agreements between users.

sections.heading: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the law of the Republic of Korea.

sections.heading: Changes
paragraphs: When these terms change, the version date above changes and you are asked to accept the new version the next time you sign in.

sections.heading: Your responsibility
paragraphs: Each person is solely responsible for working only within the rules of their own visa and residence status.
A profile on this site does not mean that the person is allowed to do a particular kind of work.

sections.heading: What the site does not do
paragraphs: We do not check, confirm or store proof of anyone's visa status. The visa type on a profile is self-declared and may be wrong.
We do not give legal or immigration advice.

sections.heading: Official information
paragraphs: For the rules of your visa, use the official HiKorea website of the Korean immigration service or ask the immigration office.

sections.heading: For clients
paragraphs: Before you hire someone, ask them whether their visa allows the work you need. You are responsible for your own hiring decision.

disclaimer.short: Visa type is self-declared and not verified. Everyone is responsible for working within their visa.
